exposure: fetal growth status (small for gestational age/fetal growth restriction)
outcome: newborn intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: The study included 131 pregnant women, with 56 cases diagnosed with small fetuses (study group) and 75 cases with appropriately grown fetuses (control group).
finding: Modified myocardial performance index was significantly higher in small fetuses compared to controls, indicating prenatal cardiac dysfunction and correlating with adverse perinatal outcomes and NICU admission.
cross-section timing: Prenatal measurements (fetal echocardiography, Doppler ultrasound) were performed at the time of inclusion.
birth_weight: Birth weights were measured and showed a significant negative correlation with modified myocardial performance index values, but no specific weight range for inclusion was specified.
gest_age: Fetuses were categorized as small for gestational age or appropriate for gestational age, but no specific gestational age range for inclusion was provided.
